{{Quote|Why weren't the Jedi able to stop this assassination? How obvious it is that we are no longer safe under the protection of the Jedi!|Darsana|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Darsana''' was a [[Anselmi/Legends|Anselmi]] who served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was in support of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] during this time.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darsana was voiced on set by [[Rob Coleman]].<ref name="AOTC BTS">{{SW|url=video/it-s-all-magic|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 6: It's All Magic}}</ref> However, his scene was cut from the final release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], and though the scene appears as one of the Deleted Scenes on the DVD, Darsana does not appear.
